checks.rationale: The six local action blocks and seven boundaries preserve the complete in-scope middle row: cell sorting, coupled lysis/RT, pooling/purification, TdT tailing, poly(dT)-primed second-strand synthesis, and combined amplification/custom library preparation. The PolyA RNA icon denotes the cellular target rather than a separately purified RNA fraction. The pooled first-strand interface is supported by the primary Figure 1a/Methods even though the poster combines it visually with tailing. Separate well reactions persist until actual contents are pooled; RNA and cDNA in the RT preparation are components of one preparation. The last block appropriately remains composite. There are no in-scope alternative routes or separately routed fractions to recover, and no joint operation has collapsed independent branches.

checks.rationale: The correction faithfully retains the poster's conflated 3.6-fold polyA-tagging/UMI-conversion wording in diagram_observation and uses registered primary Results to resolve it. The approximately 3.6-fold measurement is amplified-cDNA amount under T55 plus Increment; 30–50% read-to-UMI conversion is a separate metric. The actual tail and second_strand operations implement the selected improvement and contain no false 3.6-fold read-conversion assertion. This quantitative correction changes no reaction order, so it requires no topology reversal.
